item.title: [LU-19429] sanity-sec test_35: FAIL: failed to clear changelogs

comments.comment:
sanity-sec test 64e hit the same issue:
https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/7e28b65e-fcbd-4096-9875-dd1e8c3098a8
The failure occurred consistently on master branch.

The subtests have passed consistently on master branch since 2025-10-02.
Let me remove this ticket from the tstu list.

As Jian mentioned, this issue stopped occurring about a month ago.

Nevertheless, I've looked into the (now known duplicate LU-19366) where it seems that both tests (35 and 73) failed due to the same issue. Both tests register changelog users, which at first appear to succeed. However, when the changelog is cleared or, in the case of LU-19366, no activity from the user is logged for FS operations, the tests failed. In both cases, this happened on MDT0000 where the changelog user was not being created. Please refer to my comment in LU-19366 for further details on this issue.

The "failed to clear changelogs" signature (sanity-sec test_35 and test_64e, MDT0000 changelog user missing after register) last occurred on 2025-09-30. Rainshadow shows 18 test_35 and 4 test_64e failures on this ticket; the only ones after that carry a different signature, "failed to dump changelogs" (2026-05-06 to 2026-06-14, all on in-flight patches, none on master and none since). Jian Yu confirmed the subtests passed consistently on master from 2025-10-02, and Marc Vef traced the sibling LU-19366 to the same MDT0000 changelog-user problem. Recent test_35 failures (e.g. "changelog_mask=+hsm failed: 2" in November 2026) follow an earlier sanity-sec test_31 failure that leaves the MDT unmounted, so they are fallout from that test_31 teardown and remount problem, not a changelog bug. Nothing to fix here. Please reopen if the original signature returns on current master.
